content.json:
## 🛡️ Microsoft Sentinel — AI Governance Solution
**Version:** 0.1.0-preview | **Publisher:** x3nc0n | **Support:** GitHub Issues | **Tier:** Community

Governance observability across seven AI platform modules. Select a **persona tab** below. Use **Time Range**, **Workspace**, **Module**, **Control ID**, and **Maturity** filters.

> ⚠️ **Batch 1:** Module A (Azure OpenAI/Foundry) and Module E (Azure General) are active. Modules B–G are **planned** and require additional connectors. Missing connectors surface as **Not Configured** — never as Compliant.

### 📊 Executive Summary — AI Governance Posture
**Audience:** CISO / Security Director | **Batch:** 1 (July 2026) | **Solution:** Microsoft Sentinel — AI Governance Solution

High-level posture, active incidents, module coverage, and framework alignment. All figures reflect the selected workspace and time range.

> ⚠️ **Coverage note:** Figures reflect *deployed and connected* modules only. Modules without required connectors appear as **Not Configured** — never as Compliant. No compliance score is calculated; evidence status is stated explicitly per control.

### 🔍 SOC Operations
**Audience:** SOC Analyst / Incident Responder

Active AIGS incidents and alerts, plus live query results for Module A (Azure OpenAI/Foundry) and Module E (Azure General) — the two modules with built-in data sources active in this batch.

content.json:
---
#### Module A — Azure OpenAI / Foundry `GA` `AzureActivity (built-in)`

Rules deployed: **AIGS-CD001** (RAI Policy Modified) · **AIGS-CD005** (AI Resource Diagnostics Changed)

Hunts deployed: **AIGS-Hunt-AzureOpenAIRAIChanges** (Module A)

ASIM: `imAuditEvent — native` · Watchlists: `AIGS_ContentFilterPolicies`, `AIGS_ApprovedModels`

> **AIGS-CD001** fires on `raiPolicies/write|delete` (content filter policy changes). **AIGS-CD005** fires on `diagnosticSettings/write|delete` on CognitiveServices resources (audit continuity). Hunt queries provide broader historical coverage — see hunt sections below. Model deployment events are covered by the Module E hunt (**AIGS-Hunt-AIModelDeploymentChanges**) which also surfaces Azure OpenAI/Foundry deployment activity.

content.title: AIGS-CD001 — Content Filter Policy Changes [AzureActivity]
content.noDataMessage: No content filter policy write operations detected. If Azure OpenAI resources exist, no policy changes occurred in the time range. Absence of events does NOT confirm compliant state — run the AIGS-CD005 hunt to assess posture gaps.

content.query:
// CONTROL: AIGS-CD005  MODULE: A — Azure OpenAI / Foundry
// ASIM: imAuditEvent — native  (AzureActivity maps natively to _Im_AuditEvent)
// Detects successful write or delete of Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings
// on Microsoft.CognitiveServices resources (Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry accounts).
// A delete removes audit-log forwarding entirely (HIGH); a write may reduce logged categories (MEDIUM).
// Source: AzureActivity — built-in connector, no additional deployment required.
// Response: AIGS-Auto-001-RestoreDiagnostics (approval-gated restoration).
let DiagOps = dynamic([
    'microsoft.insights/diagnosticsettings/write',
    'microsoft.insights/diagnosticsettings/delete'
]);
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > {TimeRange:start}
| where tolower(OperationNameValue) in (DiagOps)
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success'
| where tolower(_ResourceId) contains 'microsoft.cognitiveservices'
| extend
    AccountName   = tostring(extract(@'/accounts/([^/]+)', 1, tolower(_ResourceId))),
    SettingName   = tostring(extract(@'/diagnosticsettings/([^/]+)', 1, tolower(_ResourceId))),
    OperationType = iff(tolower(OperationNameValue) has 'delete', 'Delete', 'Write')
| extend SeverityIndicator = case(
    OperationType == 'Delete', '🔴 HIGH — Diagnostic setting deleted; audit-log forwarding may be interrupted',
    OperationType == 'Write',  '🟡 MEDIUM — Diagnostic setting written; validate log categories and destinations unchanged',
    'INFO — Review required')
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    SeverityIndicator,
    OperationType,
    OperationNameValue,
    _ResourceId,
    AccountName,
    SettingName,
    Caller,
    CallerIpAddress,
    SubscriptionId,
    ResourceGroup,
    ActivityStatusValue,
    CorrelationId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: AIGS-CD005 — AI Resource Diagnostics Changed [AzureActivity]
content.noDataMessage: No diagnostic-settings changes on CognitiveServices resources in the selected time range. Absence of events does NOT confirm compliant state — verify all AI resources have active diagnostic settings via Azure Portal.

#### Module E — Azure General `GA` `AzureActivity (built-in)`

Hunt deployed: **AIGS-Hunt-AIModelDeploymentChanges** (Module E; also surfaces Azure OpenAI/Foundry deployment events — see hunt section above)

⚠️ **AIGS-AM001 analytic rule has not been authored.** The query below provides a SOC view of model deployment events. No alert fires automatically until the rule is authored and deployed. Absence of events does NOT confirm compliant state.

ASIM: `imAuditEvent — native` · Watchlist: `AIGS_ApprovedModels`

// ASIM: imAuditEvent — native

AzureActivity

    TimeGenerated,

    Caller,

    OperationNameValue,
    ActivityStatus,
    Properties=tostring(Properties)

### 🧺 Platform Health
**Audience:** AI Platform Admin / DevOps / Solution Admin

Module health status, connector availability, ASIM promotion declarations, and core table telemetry freshness. Use **Module** and **Maturity** filters.

> **isfuzzy=true pattern:** All optional-table health checks use `union isfuzzy=true`. Missing tables are silently skipped and return zero events, surfacing as **Not Configured**. No query will error due to an absent optional table.

content.json:
---
#### ASIM Promotion Declarations

This solution promotes ASIM where official schemas exist. Custom parsers (`AIGS_*`) are solution-specific normalization and are **NOT** ASIM-equivalent. They do not implement `_Im*` functions. Per binding implementation rule (Switch Finding 6): custom parsers must never be labeled as ASIM.

content.query:
datatable(DataTable:string, ASIMStatus:string, ASIMFunction:string,
          KQLHeaderComment:string, UsedInModules:string)[
    'AzureActivity',    'Native ASIM',               '_Im_AuditEvent / imAuditEvent',
        '// ASIM: imAuditEvent — native',                                    'A, E',
    'AzureDiagnostics', 'No applicable ASIM',        'N/A — Cognitive Services data-plane only',
        '// ASIM: N/A — no Cognitive Services data-plane ASIM schema',       'A (data-plane only)',
    'AgentsInfo',       'No ASIM',                   'N/A — Defender XDR proprietary inventory',
        '// ASIM: N/A — Defender XDR agent inventory table',                 'B',
    'CloudAppEvents',   'No applicable ASIM',        'N/A — cloud app governance events',
        '// ASIM: N/A — cloud app events, no applicable ASIM schema',        'D',
    'CopilotActivity',  'No ASIM',                   'N/A - direct-KQL; no _Im* parser applicable',
        '// ASIM: N/A - CopilotActivity direct-KQL, non-ASIM; no _Im* parser applicable',          'C, G',
    'OfficeActivity',   'Partial Native ASIM',        'imAuditEvent — applicable operations',
        '// ASIM: imAuditEvent — partial; N/A for Purview-specific fields',  'F',
    'SigninLogs',       'Native ASIM',               '_Im_Authentication / imAuthentication',
        '// ASIM: imAuthentication — native',                                'Identity enrichment'
]
| project DataTable, ASIMStatus, ASIMFunction, KQLHeaderComment, UsedInModules
content.title: ASIM Applicability per Table

content.query:
// Core tables guaranteed by Microsoft Sentinel baseline - no isfuzzy needed.
union
    (AzureActivity    | summarize LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
     | extend TableName='AzureActivity',    Role='Required - Modules A, E'),
    (SecurityIncident | summarize LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
     | extend TableName='SecurityIncident',  Role='Required - SOC Operations'),
    (SecurityAlert    | summarize LastEvent=max(TimeGenerated)
     | extend TableName='SecurityAlert',     Role='Required - SOC Operations')
| extend AgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), LastEvent)
| extend FreshnessStatus = case(
    isnull(LastEvent), 'No data',
    AgeDays <= 1, 'Fresh (< 1 day)',
    AgeDays <= 7, 'Stale (1-7 days)',
    'Overdue (> 7 days)'
  )
| project TableName, LastEvent, AgeDays, FreshnessStatus, Role
content.title: Core Table Freshness — AzureActivity, SecurityIncident, SecurityAlert
content.noDataMessage: Core table freshness check failed. At least one required table may be missing.

// Module B - current Agent 365 inventory posture.
// AgentsInfo is an hourly snapshot; arg_max selects the latest row per AgentId.
// isfuzzy=true keeps the query valid when the Preview table is unavailable.
union isfuzzy=true
    (AgentsInfo
     | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
     | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by AgentId
     | extend GuardrailsText=tostring(Guardrails)
     | extend DeclaredGuardrailStatus=case(
          isempty(GuardrailsText) or GuardrailsText in ('null','[]','{}'), 'No declared guardrails',
          'Declared guardrails present'
       )
     | project Timestamp, AgentId, AgentName, Platform, Version,
               LifecycleStatus, PublishedStatus, DeclaredGuardrailStatus,
               LastUpdatedDateTime, EntraAgentId),
    (print Timestamp=datetime(null), AgentId='', AgentName='', Platform='', Version='',
           LifecycleStatus='', PublishedStatus='', DeclaredGuardrailStatus='',
           LastUpdatedDateTime=datetime(null), EntraAgentId=''
     | where false)
| order by Timestamp desc

content.query:
// Module C - M365 Copilot agent model observed-state inventory.
// arg_max selects the latest observed event per AgentId over the selected time range.
// isfuzzy=true keeps the query valid when CopilotActivity is unavailable.
union isfuzzy=true
    (CopilotActivity
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | project TimeGenerated, AgentId, AgentName, Workload, AppHost,
               AIModelName, AIModelVersion, ActorName, ActorUserId
     | summarize
         EventCount       = count(),
         ObservedModels   = make_set(AIModelName),
         ObservedVersions = make_set(AIModelVersion),
         ObservedHosts    = make_set(AppHost),
         LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
       by AgentId, AgentName, Workload),
    (print AgentId = '', AgentName = '', Workload = '',
           EventCount = 0, ObservedModels = dynamic([]),
           ObservedVersions = dynamic([]), ObservedHosts = dynamic([]),
           LastSeen = datetime(null)
     | where false)
| order by LastSeen desc

content.query:
// Module C - observed model drift against AIGS_M365CopilotBaseline.
// Mirrors AIGS-CD003 detection logic; visible in the workbook regardless of incident state.
// isfuzzy=true: returns empty when CopilotActivity is absent.
let Baseline = materialize(
    _GetWatchlist("AIGS_M365CopilotBaseline")
    | where Status =~ "Active"
    | project
        WL_AgentId       = tolower(tostring(AgentId)),
        WL_AgentName     = tostring(AgentName),
        WL_ExpModel      = tostring(ExpectedModelName),
        WL_ExpVersion    = tostring(ExpectedModelVersion),
        WL_Owner         = tostring(BaselineOwner)
);
union isfuzzy=true
    (CopilotActivity
     | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
     | project TimeGenerated, AgentId, AgentName, Workload, AppHost,
               AIModelName, AIModelVersion, ActorName, ActorUserId
     | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AgentId
     | extend NormalizedAgentId = tolower(tostring(AgentId))),
    (print TimeGenerated = datetime(null), AgentId = '', AgentName = '',
           Workload = '', AppHost = '', AIModelName = '', AIModelVersion = '',
           ActorName = '', ActorUserId = '', NormalizedAgentId = ''
     | where false)
| join kind=inner (Baseline) on $left.NormalizedAgentId == $right.WL_AgentId
| extend
    ModelDrift   = isnotempty(WL_ExpModel) and tolower(AIModelName) != tolower(WL_ExpModel),
    VersionDrift = isnotempty(WL_ExpVersion) and tolower(AIModelVersion) != tolower(WL_ExpVersion)
| where ModelDrift or VersionDrift
| extend DriftType = case(
    ModelDrift and VersionDrift, "Model name and version drift",
    ModelDrift, "Model name drift",
    "Model version drift"
  )
| project TimeGenerated, AgentId, AgentName, Workload, AppHost,
          AIModelName, AIModelVersion, WL_ExpModel, WL_ExpVersion,
          DriftType, WL_Owner
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: M365 Copilot Agent Model Drift (vs. AIGS_M365CopilotBaseline) — Module C
content.noDataMessage: No drift detected — or CopilotActivity absent / AIGS_M365CopilotBaseline has no Active rows. Install the Microsoft Copilot Data Connector and populate the baseline to enable this view.

#### Connector Installation Guide

| Module | Connector | Location | Notes |
|--------|-----------|----------|-------|
| A, E | Azure Activity | Built-in | No action needed |
| B, D | Microsoft Defender XDR | Content Hub → Defender XDR | Requires M365 E5 or Defender for Cloud Apps |
| C, G | Microsoft Copilot Data Connector | Content Hub → Microsoft Copilot | GA; schema stable (connector ID: MicrosoftCopilot) |
| F | Office 365 | Content Hub → Office 365 | Installed. Activate Purview AI Hub and generate activity. |
| G | Security Copilot UAL | Security Copilot Owner Settings | Toggle: *Logging audit data in Microsoft Purview*. SCU provisioning required. |

> **Module G gate:** `enableSecurityCopilotModule` ARM parameter must be `true` (default: `false`). Requires delegated OAuth credential — UAMI not supported for Security Copilot API (explicit architectural exception).
